message.text:
DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook maps to memos.memo.created. DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook maps to memos.memo.updated.

DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook maps to memos.memo.deleted. DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook maps to memos.memo.comment.created. All three converge at dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook, which calls webhook.PostAsync in internal/webhook/webhook.go. That function then uses Post() for actual HTTP delivery.

Created, updated, and deleted memos route through dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook before reaching PostAsync. Comments go straight to PostAsync. All paths converge at webhook.PostAsync in internal/webhook/webhook.go, which queues to Post() for HTTP delivery.

q30.
memo created: DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook
memo updated: DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook
memo deleted: DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook
memo comment created: DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook
webhook.PostAsync — internal/webhook/webhook.go

All four live in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. Created/updated/deleted go through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`; comment created posts directly. Both paths call `webhook.PostAsync`, which queues `Post` for HTTP delivery.
